data.name: QuestDocument.Avalon.MeetSkadi
data.value:
Find Adventurer Skadi in Ricarten.
She introduces your starter equipment and the Adventurer Journey's first hunt.

data.name: QuestDocument.Avalon.MeetJin
data.value:
Find Adventurer Jin in Pillai.
He introduces your starter equipment and the Adventurer Journey's first hunt.

data.name: QuestDocument.Avalon.Preparation
data.value:
Equip your starter weapon and place a potion in your belt.
Return to your Journey guide for the first hunt's instructions.
This step grants experience, 500 Gold and 15 small life potions.

data.name: QuestDocument.Avalon.SkadiHunt
data.value:
Defeat 3 Hopys in the starting forest.
Continue hunting until you obtain the requested crystal, then deliver it to Adventurer Skadi in Ricarten.
The delivery grants experience and 300 Gold.

data.name: QuestDocument.Avalon.JinHunt
data.value:
Defeat 3 Rabies in the forest outside Pillai.
Continue hunting until you obtain the requested crystal, then deliver it to Adventurer Jin in Pillai.
The delivery grants experience and 300 Gold.

data.name: QuestDocument.Avalon.Finished
data.value:
You completed the Adventurer Journey.
Your preparation and first hunt with your tribe's guide are complete.

data.name: QuestDocument.Avalon.JourneyStart
data.value:
Welcome to the Adventurer Journey.
Receive your starter equipment, equip your weapon and place a potion in your belt. Talk to me again when you are ready.

data.name: QuestDocument.Avalon.JourneyBag
data.value:
Equip your starter weapon and put at least one potion in your belt before continuing.
If a starter equipment piece is missing, talk to me to receive it.

data.name: QuestDocument.Avalon.JourneyHuntSkadi
data.value:
Your first hunt takes place in the forest north of Ricarten.
Defeat 3 Hopys, obtain the requested crystal and return to talk to me.

data.name: QuestDocument.Avalon.JourneyHuntJin
data.value:
Your first hunt takes place in the forest near Pillai.
Defeat 3 Rabies, obtain the requested crystal and return to talk to me.

data.name: QuestDocument.Avalon.JourneyCollect
data.value:
Complete the hunt and bring the requested crystal.
After defeating the three monsters, keep hunting until you collect the crystal.

data.name: QuestDocument.Avalon.JourneyFinish
data.value:
You completed your first hunt.
Deliver the crystal to receive experience and 300 Gold and complete the Adventurer Journey.
